events.description: 2026-10-21 media reports prosecutors investigating alleged false transactions concerning a 2021-era solar business; the company released a statement about the former management case. No verified financial-statement restatement or corresponding affected FY annual figures are established. Investigation allegation only; do not assign financial-restatement Y=1.

Company announcement says board approved restated 2022 annual and periods through 2023 annual reports; fair value and deferred tax asset accounting. Financial values and filing vintages must still be sourced.
Company announcement says 2023 consolidated and individual annual statements were restated, plus 2024 Q2/Q3. Goodwill impairment increase TWD 42,464 thousand; company hosts restated PDFs.

Company notice distinguishes original 2021 CONSOLIDATED annual restatement from 2022/2023 consolidated annual CORRECTIONS and 2021-23 individual annual restatements; no automatic same-category label for each year.
Regulator required FY2023 statement re-audit/re-publication following limited audit evidence about equity-method investment; evidence shows order, not independent proof of completed restatement.
